FN-I35HQ6Z-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 90
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Adline Clarke
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 03/31/2025
House Bill 90 as introduced would exempt municipal housing authorities from all taxes, which
would decrease receipts to various entities and funds by an undetermined amount, including the
State General Fund, Education Trust Fund, county and municipal funds.
This bill would also provide further for the powers of such authority, including the making of
certain debts or equity financing, creation of profit or not-for-profit subsidiaries or other
business organizations, and contracting for design-build agreements.

FN-I35HQ6Z-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 90
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Adline Clarke
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 04/03/2025
House Bill 90 as reported by the Committee on State Government would exempt municipal
housing authorities from state taxes, which would decrease receipts to the State General Fund,
Education Trust Fund, and various other entities and funds by an undetermined amount.
This bill could also decrease receipts to county and municipal funds by an undetermined
amount, if the county commission adopts a resolution pertaining to the respective county taxes.
This bill would also provide further for the powers of such authority, including the making of
certain debts or equity financing, creation of profit or not-for-profit subsidiaries or other
business organizations, and contracting for design-build agreements.
